prompt:
Create one original English learning poem card, portrait, watercolor and colored pencil on warm cream paper, cheerful pastel palette, polished children's picture-book illustration consistent with a gentle educational series. Upper 52% scene: A kind doctor and nurse reassuring a child in a bright welcoming clinic. Lower 48% cream reading area with large exceptionally clear dark navy serif typography. Exact title: "The Hospital". Render these EXACT SIX LINES of the poem, verbatim, all fully visible with generous margins:
Doctor, nurse, the hospital door.
One sick child can smile again.
Care for the child, check the heart.
Help the body, play one part.
Not alone and not afraid.
Hope can grow with every day.
Do not add any other text. Original generic characters only, no brands, existing characters, recognizable artwork, or imitation of named artists. Readable text is crucial.
